system.descricao: Wind Demon Clan: Fuuma Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 7 WIND DEMON You possess the talent and ambition of one of the most renowned clans. Prerequisite: Tensai (Secret Technique). Benefit: You must choose this skill as one of the two Special Skills you are entitled to through the Tensai secret technique. You receive the benefits of the Weapon Proficiency (Fuuma Shuriken) and Expertise (Throwing Weapons) skills. Additionally, you can make the base damage of any fuuma shuriken attack equal to your Dexterity level (that is, the standard base damage calculation for throwing weapons is not used, nor is weapon damage). You will not receive the benefits of skills for which you have not yet met the normal purchase prerequisites, but you will receive them as soon as those prerequisites are met.

Aquatic Predator Clan: Hoshigaki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 8 Benefit: Your skin is thick and covered in hard scales. You also possess gills and a row of sharp teeth. In addition to being able to breathe underwater and move within it at twice your speed, your special skin also grants you Body Hardness 1 against all types of armed and unarmed attacks. With Stamina 8, it increases to Body Hardness 2. And with Stamina 12, it increases to Body Hardness 3. NATURAL ELEMENT: SUITON

Natural Element: Suiton Clan: Hoshigaki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 8 Its biological proximity to ocean predators made it especially skilled in the use of Suiton. Prerequisite: Aquatic Predator; Suiton 1. Benefit: Every Suiton effect receives +2 base damage as an elemental bonus (functioning the same way as the additional damage from Katon, for example). WATER RESERVOIR

Water Reservoir Clan: Hoshigaki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 9 Prerequisite: Suiton 5, Spirit 9, Water Mastery, Element Natural. Benefit: You are able to project water with extreme ease. When using the Water Mastery skill, you accumulate twice the possible water points. All other rules of Water Mastery remain in effect. SUITON: EFFECTS FOR HOSHIGAKI When you purchase the restricted abilities of the Hoshigaki clan, you gain access to new effects for Suiton (Water Release). LEVEL 10 EFFECTS

Shark Prison Clan: Hoshigaki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 9 Effect level: 10 Shark Prison • Prerequisites: Water Prison Lv 9; Wave Collision Lv 8; Natural Element: Suiton; Aquatic Predator; Water Reserve. Action : Complete • Area of Effect: Sphere twice the size of the normal power. • Duration: Sustained You create a gigantic dome of water around yourself and capture everyone within its area of effect. Using Shark Prison requires a DC roll against the enemies' Evade maneuver or another defense that allows you to leave the area of effect. If there is no other defense or sufficient movement, it is an Automatic Success. The dome has zero hardness and absorption equal to 6 per level of power used. Captured victims will need to make Athletics tests to swim and attempt to escape the prison (Standard Difficulty) or Stamina tests to simply hold their breath (Standard Difficulty -2). Failing will result in suffocation. Whenever a victim moves within the prison, you can immediately spend a move action to move in the same direction as them and also move the entire water dome along with you, thus preventing the target from escaping the prison. If two or more targets move in different directions at the same time, you can only choose one direction to pursue. KUCHIYOSE: SHARK

Kuchiyose: Shark Clan: Hoshigaki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 9 Low Intelligence: Sharks always have zero Intelligence and automatically fail any Intelligence test. For the same reason, they are unable to speak. However, they can still be commanded, executing simple orders without any difficulty (such as attacking, defending, or even delivering written messages). Numerous Summoning: You can summon up to 8 sharks at the same time, all at the highest level your power allows. However, they fail any Combat Skill test (except for the School Attack) and are considered henchmen. Size: Sharks are limited to the Large size. Key Attributes: Strength, Agility, Perception. Skills: Athletics (Swimming), Alertness, Tracking. Powers: None. Skills: Attack in Motion, Specialist, Reflexes, Speedster, Expert, Innate Skill, Stunning Attack, Power Attack, Sensor (continuous duration). Techniques: • School Attack: After summoning a large number of 8 sharks, you can order them to attack

School Attack (Shark Summoning) Clan: Hoshigaki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 10 the same target in succession to disrupt its movements. You make a single CC check for all creatures, using the highest accuracy among them. If you are successful, the victim will receive the following limitations on their next defense: they cannot use the Evade maneuver or any other defense that requires movement; and they are caught off guard if they defend using Dodge or Anticipate. It is possible to defend using a technique, provided it can be used while submerged. The Shoal Attack does not cause damage, requires a full action from all creatures, and does not count towards damage reduction under the Partners rule. Types of Attacks: Bite (piercing), Body Slam (crushing).

Suika (Hydration) Clan: Hozuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 10 SUIKA You are able to transform your entire body and your clothes into water. Prerequisite: Suiton 4; Spirit 9 Benefit: You transform entirely into water and become nearly immune to physical attacks of any kind. The benefits of this ability They have a permanent duration, but you only receive them as long as you possess chakra. Suika Points: You gain a new parameter called Suika Points (SP) which is equal to 3 times your Stamina. Whenever you suffer any type of damage, you can deduct it from your Suika Points instead of your Vitality. If your SP value reaches zero, all remaining damage is deducted from your Vitality. Fluid Immunity: You become immune to damage from Suiton-type techniques, but not to secondary effects unrelated to water itself, such as being pushed. You are also immune to suffocation damage in drowning situations. You also only receive half the base damage from Katon techniques. (and fire-type damage, such as explosive tags), but receives double damage against Raiton techniques (and electrical-type damage). Fluid Escape: When immobilized by any physical restraint (such as ropes, cells, or the Grab maneuver), you can use a standard action to transform into liquid to escape immediately, without needing to make any tests, and then return to normal. Additionally, you receive the Immerse level 2 effect for your Suiton power for free. Fluid Power: Suika Points can be used to replace the chakra cost of Suiton techniques, paying 1 PS for each chakra point that would be spent. Whenever the technique's cost is fully paid with PS, the Suiton technique receives +2 damage. This damage bonus is incompatible with the Water Mastery skill and the Energize effect. Water Gun: When using the Cannon effect for Suiton, you can fire small projectiles with the tip of your index finger, as if it were a firearm. Using the effect in this way does not require hand seals. Hydrate: With a full night's rest, you recover HP at a rate of 5 points +2 per level of Stamina. The GM may reduce or even prevent HP recovery if you do not have access to drinking water during the day. Elemental Restriction: When you purchase this ability, you are unable to use any elemental power other than Suiton (Water Release). Time Constraint: The benefits of this skill are not affected by Accelerated Technique. SUITON: SUIKA EFFECTS When you purchase the Suika skill, you gain access to new effects for Suiton. LEVEL 5 EFFECTS WATER ARM

Water Arm Clan: Hozuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 12 Effect level: 5 • Prerequisite: Suika (aptitude) • Action: Partial • Scope: Personal • Damage: see text • Duration: Continuous • Chakra Cost: 1 By using this ability, you can make one of your arms larger and stronger. While using the water arm, you can use Spirit instead of Strength for tests, test difficulties, and damage calculation of melee attacks. You can also use Spirit to meet Strength prerequisites in skills, powers, and weapon use. In addition, you become able to use the Finesse skill for any heavy weapon, including special weapons. This effect can be used with maneuvering skills. LEVEL 6 EFFECTS

To Swamp (Water Suffocation) Clan: Hozuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 12 Effect level: 6 TO SWAMP • Prerequisite: Suika (aptitude) • Action: Movement (see text) • Range: Touch (see text) • Damage: see text • Duration: Continuous After liquefying a part of your body, you manipulate the resulting water to surround the target's head, preventing them from breathing. This technique should be used on a grabbed target, as a movement action. You transform part of your body into water and envelop the target's head with it, creating a bubble, which is then separated from your body (once the technique is completed, it is no longer necessary to have the target grabbed to maintain it). The target will suffer suffocation, with fixed damage equal to the base damage value of the power. To break free, the victim needs to cause any damage to the bubble formed on their head. The bubble has absorption 1, common power hardness, and... still retaining the same natural advantages and disadvantages of Suika fitness (see Fluid Immunity). Another way to use this technique is as a prepared action after a successful unarmed block. After making contact with the target, you separate the body part, creating the bubble around its head. LEVEL 7 EFFECTS

Water Monster Clan: Hozuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 13 Effect level: 7 WATER MONSTER • Prerequisites: Suika (aptitude); Water Arm (effect) Action : Pattern • Scope: Personal • Duration: Sustained You can merge with a large amount of existing water to transform into a giant spherical monster. Your size category changes to Huge , and all your melee attacks receive the benefits of the Water Arm effect, with a +3 bonus to Spirit when replacing Strength checks and damage calculations. LEVEL 8 EFFECTS OIL CLONE

Oil Clone Clan: Hozuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 13 Effect level: 8 • Prerequisites: Suika (aptitude); Clone (Mizu Bunshin; aptitude) Action : Pattern • Scope: Personal • Duration: Concentration This is an infinite cyclical explosion technique, by which the user creates a clone (resembling a chibi version of themselves) made of water and oil. The clone's exterior is made of a thin layer of oil, while the interior is filled with water. Growth: As the clone moves, the oil on the surface layer heats up rapidly, evaporating the water inside and causing it to grow larger. As long as it moved in that round, in the following round, at the start of its turn, the clone increases by 1 size category. Heating: At the start of the turn in which it reaches the Huge size, the internal temperature of the steam reaches its limit and the clone explodes, releasing all the water vapor inside it at once. Explosion: The explosion is shaped like a sphere of the usual power size, and all those hit will suffer normal damage +2. Because it is a water vapor explosion, the user does not suffer damage, thanks to the Suika aptitude. Cooling: After being released in the explosion, the vapor rises into the sky and cools, transforming into hail, which falls on the clone and lowers its temperature, causing it to return to its original size and restart the cycle for a new explosion. The oil clone follows the same rules as the Mizu Bunshin, but is extremely fast, being considered accelerated. It attacks only in melee combat using a large axe (weapon damage +5) that unfolds from its arm. If you have the Water Arm or Energize effect for Suiton, you can use Spirit in the melee damage calculation. The clone possesses Vitality equal to 3x its Spirit level, is immune to damage from common armed and unarmed attacks (without the use of chakra or Hijutsu), and possesses the same natural advantages and disadvantages as the Suika aptitude (see Fluid Immunity). Controlling the clone requires concentration, and you cannot control other types of clones at the same time. However, the Oil Clone is not affected by the damage reduction rule of the Command Partner rule.

Bone Craftsman Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 14 BONE CRAFTSMAN You are able to remove bones from your body and shape them as you see fit to create various weapons. Furthermore, your control over bone regeneration allows you to make any removed bones grow back almost immediately, making you a human arsenal. Benefit: Creating a weapon requires removing bones from a limb, usually an arm. Doing so will render the limb unusable until the start of your next turn, while the removed bones... They rebuild. You are proficient with all weapons created through this skill (meaning you don't need to purchase the Weapon Proficiency skill), and only characters with this skill are proficient in using bone weapons. All bone weapons are considered Special Weapons (see page 82), with the following rules. Crafting: Only light, medium, long, or heavy weapons of the cutting or piercing type can be crafted, and the Strength and Dexterity requirements must be met to use them. You are not able to create mechanically complex weapons or weapons dependent on chemicals. Weapons last for 1 scene. The cost of creating the weapon depends on its category: • Light Weapons: partial action and 1 point of Vitality per weapon. • Medium Weapons: partial action and 2 Vitality points per weapon. • Long or Heavy Weapons: movement action and 4 Vitality points per weapon. These costs are also used in the creation of Shikotsumyaku's special weapons (such as fang- weapons and the Hana). The action cost to create the weapons is not affected by the Quick Draw skill. Weapon Quality: The weapons possess the same properties and damage as their standard version (see Weapon Table in the Basic Rulebook, p. 137), but with +2 hardness and increased weapon damage by +1. They can also be used to block projectile-type techniques.

Teshi Sendan (Finger Bullets) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 15 Teshi Sendan: At the cost of 1 Vit point, projectiles are created from the finger bones and fired immediately with a standard action (the fired bones regenerate instantly). This is a ranged attack with a 20m range and base damage equal to the Dexterity level.

Weapon-Fang (Bone Weapon) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 15 Weapon-Fang: This is a special light weapon. You cause long, pointed bones to sprout from the palms of your hands (one or both). These bones have the damage of any light weapon you choose. Once created, the weapons-fang can be retracted with a free action. While wielding a weapon attached to your hand, you cannot create other weapons, but you cannot be targeted by the disarm maneuver, and your limb will not become unusable. Shikotsumyaku Specialist: If you choose Shikotsumyaku for your Specialist skill, you receive its benefit for all bone weapons. BONE ARMOR

Bone Armor Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 15 You are covered with powerful bones. Benefit: This endoskeleton lines your structure beneath the skin and grants you Body Hardness 1 against all types of damage. Additionally, you gain the benefits of the Die Hard fitness level and become immune to fractures. With Vigor 10, it increases to body hardness 2. And with Vigor 14, it increases to body hardness 3.

Karamatsu no Mai (Larch Dance) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 15 Karamatsu no Mai (Larch Dance) Several bones emerge from the body all at once, to absorb damage and also to counterattack enemies that physically attack. Prerequisite: Stamina 6, Bone Craftsman, Bone Armor Benefit: This skill grants you a new defensive technique. Using Karamatsu no Mai as a defensive action is a Defender with Technique maneuver in which, instead of using your LM in the defense test, you can use your CC level, including the benefit of the Expert skill (if any). Using Karamatsu no Mai is a partial action and costs chakra points equal to 1/4 of your Stamina level. If successful, you instantly gain extra body hardness points equal to your Stamina level, reinforcing your bone structure beneath the skin and also causing bones to protrude from your body to absorb damage. This extra hardness remains until the end of the turn of the enemy that attacked you and is cumulative with Bone Armor. Additionally, enemies that have attacked the character unarmed will suffer fixed damage equal to 1 per level of Stamina. The damage is only suffered by the attacker if you succeed on the CC test, and is still suffered even if the body toughness is overcome by the attack. Using this defense against an unarmed grab attempt grants you a +2 accuracy check. If you succeed, the enemy takes damage, and you are entitled to a roll to escape the maneuver as a reaction, following its normal rules. If you use this technique against enemies who are already grappling you, it costs a standard action, and the fixed damage is halved. YANAGI NO MAI (WOOD TREE DANCE)

Yanagi no Mai (Willow Dance) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 16 You attack with jumps, acrobatics, and somersaults, using claw-weapons and secondary weapons grown from your elbows, knees, and shoulders, which can be retracted at the end of the technique. Prerequisite: Acrobatics 6, Bone Craftsman Benefit: To use this technique, you must initially have your hands free or be wielding only weapons. Your melee attack gains the benefits of the Spinning Attack skill. If you attack with the Multiple Attack skill, all attacks are considered spinning attacks. This technique cannot be used with other dances or maneuver skills. Special: Whenever you attack with a light bone weapon, whether it's a regular attack, in this dance, or any other, you can use Dexterity instead of Strength when calculating damage.

Tsubaki no Mai (Camellia Dance) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 16 TSUBAKI NO MAI (DANCE OF THE CAMELLIA) Combining quick movements with an unpredictable combat rhythm, you use a light bone weapon to strike your opponent in the most agile and lethal way possible. Prerequisites: Agility 8; Moving Attack; Multi-Attack; Bone Craftsman. Benefit: You must be wielding only light weapons to use this technique and you must be 3 meters or more away from your target. You use the Multiple Attack skill to attack three times, increasing the speed of each attack: the second attack causes a -1 penalty to the target's defense and the third attack causes a -2 penalty to the accuracy (this -2 penalty is also applied to the Progressive Attack test). All attacks must be made against the same target. You also receive the benefits of the Quick Retreat and Cleave Lv 2 skills. Additionally, whenever you kill an enemy, you will receive an extra movement of up to 5m to move to a new target before attacking with Cleave. This technique cannot be used with other dances.

Tessenka no Mai (Clematis Dance) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 17 TESSENKA NO MAI (DANCE OF THE CLEMATITE) The Clematis Dance is divided into two parts. In the first, the user creates a dense whip made from the bones of the spine and uses it to restrain the enemy. In the second, they create a large spear in their free arm and pierce the immobilized target. Prerequisite: Stamina 12; Strength or Dexterity 10, Bone Craftsman, Ambidexterity. Benefit: You are able to create two special and unique heavy weapons: the Bone Vine and the Bone Flower. These weapons can be wielded simultaneously, but are never used together in the same attack. Tsuru (Bone Vine): The user can modify and remove their own spinal column and regenerate

Tsuru (Bone Vine) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 17 a new one to replace it immediately, without incurring any penalties for the absence of bones. Between the gaps in the bones, there is cartilage that allows for flexibility, making it possible to bend it as if it were a dense, sharp whip. The Bone Vine is a heavy weapon with +4 weapon damage (including the Bone Craftsman bonus). It can attack targets up to 4 meters away and also perform the trip, disarm, or grapple maneuvers without accuracy penalties. The Finesse skill applies to... this weapon.

Hana (Bone Flower) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 17 Hana (Bone Flower): The user utilizes chakra to make the bones of one arm grow astonishingly, creating a large spear capable of vibrating, increasing its piercing power. Hana is a heavy weapon-fang, with weapon damage of +6 (Bone Artisan bonus already included) and a melee reach of 2m. If you are grappling a target using the Tsuru, you receive an extra melee attack against that same target, exclusively for attacking using the Hana. This dance cannot be used with maneuvering skills.

Sawarabi no Mai (Fern Dance) Clan: Kaguya Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 17 SAWARABI NO MAI (FERN DANCE) In the last of the five dances of the Kaguya Clan, countless bone spears rise from underground, which can number in the thousands for the highest-level ninjas. Prerequisite: Vigor 16; Tessenka no Mai. Benefit: With a standard action, you create several spears around you that rise from the ground to pierce enemies. This dance functions like the Ninpou Level 6 Spear effect (see the Basic Rulebook, p. 99), with the following parameters: • Size: Each spear is 1m in diameter, 3m high, and spreads out around the user in an area with a diameter equal to their Stamina level. • Hardness: 2x the level of Vigor • Base Damage: 1 per Stamina level Chakra cost: half of Stamina. • Test Difficulty: 9 + Vigor. You can enter and move inside any spear, as when using the Immerse Lv 4 (Doton) effect. If you have Stamina 18, the Spear effect is increased to Lv 9. This technique cannot be used with other dances or maneuvering skills.

Moon Blade Clan: Yotsuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 18 MOON BLADE You possess the unparalleled swordsmanship skills of one of the clans with the highest loyalty among its members. Prerequisite: Tensai (Secret Technique). Benefit: You must choose this skill as one of the two Special Skills you are entitled to through the Tensai secret technique. You receive the benefits of the Finesse and Lightning Mastery aptitudes. Additionally, you receive the Weapon Proficiency aptitude for all types of martial swords. You still need to meet the Strength and Dexterity requirements. to use medium and heavy weapons. You will not receive the benefits of skills for which you have not yet met the normal purchase prerequisites, but you will receive them as soon as those prerequisites are met.

Special Seals (One-Handed Seals) Clan: Yuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 18 Prerequisite: Dexterity 8 Benefit: You are able to perform hand seals with one hand, allowing you to attack or hold objects with the other. You must have at least one hand free to benefit from this ability. You do not receive the -3 penalty to accuracy when using techniques in close combat (nor do you need to make a concentration check). Additionally, when using the common Strike maneuver, if your melee attack is blocked, dodged, or anticipated, you can perform a standard action technique as a move action. The technique performed must be an offensive ranged attack, with a DC check, and have an instantaneous duration. Normal: You need to have both hands free to perform hand seals.

Freezing Clan: Yuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 19 FREEZING You can freeze enemies each time you hit with a Hyouton technique. Prerequisite: Hyouton 6. Benefit: Whenever damage is dealt with an effect of the Hyouton power, the victim must make a Stamina test (Standard difficulty -2). If they fail, they are incapacitated until the end of their next turn. This ability only applies to ranged effects that require a hit test against the target's defensive action. Therefore, it also does not apply to attacks with the Energize or Create Weapon effects. HYOUTON (ICE ELEMENT)

Hyouton (Ice Release) Clan: Yuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 19 Restricted Power Hyouton is an advanced bloodline formed through the simultaneous use of the Wind and Water elements to create ice. It allows the user to freely create and manipulate ice by combining these elements. When the user releases their chakra, the area around them becomes so cold that it snows, and the ice produced is so resistant that it can withstand even fire-type attacks, melting only minimally. The player must purchase Hyouton as a standard version of elemental ninjutsu powers. The Hyouton power follows the same rules as the Ninpou power (see the Powers chapter in the Basic Rulebook, page 91), and can utilize all of its effects without restriction. Hyouton has the same range and size as the Ninpou power. Range: Medium (10m + 2m per Spirit level). The character can only manipulate or create their element up to the maximum range of their power. Size: Creations, manipulations, and areas of effect can have up to 1m in diameter, length, width, or height per Spirit level. Additional Hardness: Every Hyouton creation has 2 additional hardness points. Increased Resistance Difficulty: All Hyouton effects receive a +1 bonus to the resistance difficulty for target tests. Allowed Effects: All Ninpou effects; Immerse (Doton); Special Permanent Duration: Hyouton element effects and creations that have a permanent duration melt away after 1 hour per level used. Wind Release and Water Release: The character receives 1 free level in Wind Release and Water Release, and can use the Cannon Effect for Wind Release and Water Release using the level of Water Release as a parameter. If you want more levels in these powers to achieve more effects, you need to evolve them separately. Element Restriction: The character cannot learn elements other than Hyouton, Suiton, and Fuuton. The Hyouton power also possesses the following unique effects. LEVEL 6 EFFECT DEMONIC MIRRORS

Demonic Mirrors Clan: Yuki Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1 (4.1b), page 20 Effect level: 6 • Prerequisite: Attack in Motion (skill), Immerse (effect) Action : Pattern • Area of Effect: Hemisphere; diameter 1m per power level • Duration: Continuous • Chakra Cost: 3 per turn You create 21 ice mirrors, each 5 cm thick, that form a dome around you and trap nearby enemies in a special field. Usage: Using the Mirrors requires a DC roll against the enemies' Evade maneuver or another defense that allows you to leave the area of effect. If there is no other defense or sufficient movement, it is an Automatic Success. Movement: You can enter a nearby mirror with a free action. Moving from one mirror to any other is a movement action. Protection: While inside the mirrors, you are protected by them, which have zero hardness (no elemental bonus is applied) and absorption equal to 8 per level of power used. If all the mirror's absorption is reduced to zero, you suffer the excess damage. Reflections: All mirrors reflect your image, making you undetectable to the naked eye. Whenever you are targeted by a projectile or area attack that cannot hit all mirrors, the enemy must roll 1 die before their attack. If the result is 4 or less, it means the attack was directed at a reflection of you in one of the mirrors. Damage to the mirror is applied normally, but you do not suffer excess damage if the mirror is broken. Characters with Kagura Shingan or Chakra Vision will always be able to distinguish you from your reflections and are not affected by this. rule. Attacking: You need to step out of the mirror to perform attacks or cast techniques. When moving from one mirror to another, you are considered accelerated and can use the accelerated feint for ranged attacks with weapons, projectiles, and also for the Cannon effect. Defending: When attacked, you can perform a Dodge or the Anticipate maneuver to move to the nearest mirror as a reaction, or use the Evade maneuver to move to any mirror of your choice. Escapes: There are gaps between the mirrors, allowing anyone to enter the special field. However, attempting to escape through one of these gaps (either independently or with the help of an ally) opens a chance for a timely attack, which can be carried out with melee combat or at range with simple throwing weapons. or cannon effect. Mirror Breaking: When absorption is reduced to zero, the number of mirrors broken depends on the attacks made. If all attacks hit all mirrors, then all mirrors are destroyed at the same time. But if at least one attack did not hit all mirrors, only one mirror is broken. If an enemy passes through the space of a destroyed mirror, they will not be at risk of an opportune attack. They will also not be at risk if they are Super Accelerated (but only those in Accelerated mode are still at risk). Rebuild: You can still use a move action to completely renew the absorption of all damaged mirrors or recreate any destroyed mirror. Single Mirror: While the technique is active, you can create a single mirror at any point within the common range of the power, as a free action, which can be used to move to that point using the benefits of this effect. Evolutions: • Demonic Mirrors Level 8: The mirrors now have a hardness of 2. Moving from one mirror to another becomes a partial action. You can use the accelerated feint to attack with the Arrows effect. You can also use Arrows in opportune attacks. The chakra cost increases to 4 per turn.
The Fuuma clan lists Tensai as its Hijutsu. Full rules are in Basic Book p.241; not reprinted here. Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1, p.7
Restricted to Hoshigaki here; refer to Uzumaki clan in Basic Book p.193 for full mechanics. Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1, p.8
Exclusive summoning technique: Shark, using Kuchiyose as a common power. See the shark rules on pages 9–10. Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1, p.8
Listed in the Kaguya skill set; see Uzumaki Clan, Basic Book p.193. Source: Book of Hijutsus Vol. 1, p.14
